row.name: items_with_tax
row.definition: select "invoice_item"."id", "invoice_item"."invoice_id", "invoice_item"."label", "invoice_item"."note", "invoice_item"."quantity", "invoice_item"."unit", "invoice_item"."unit_cost", "invoice_item"."net_amount", "invoice_item"."order", "invoice_item"."config_id", "config"."tax_registration", ((1 + COALESCE(sum("tax"."rate") * "config"."tax_registration"::INT, 0)) * "invoice_item"."net_amount")::NUMERIC(15, 4) as "gross_amount" from "invoice_item" left join "item_tax" on "item_tax"."item_id" = "invoice_item"."id" left join "tax" on "item_tax"."tax_id" = "tax"."id" left join "invoice" on "invoice_item"."invoice_id" = "invoice"."id" left join "config" on "invoice"."config_id" = "config"."id" group by "invoice_item"."id", "config"."id"
